key_decisions: requiredModels entries are SLOTS now (MPI-599): `{ label: 'Image model', models: [...5 SDXL] }` and `{ label: 'Edit model', models: ['klein-4b'] }`. Write the edit slot as a SLOT even with one candidate - it becomes choosable the moment MPI-598 lands Klein 9B, and only the array grows. A one-candidate slot renders no dropdown, so it costs the user nothing today.
models[0] is the RECOMMENDED candidate - declaration order IS preference order, and the picker stars it. There is no `recommended` field; reorder the list instead.
Each slot needs its OWN Input_*-titled node in the graph. Two slots writing the same title is one slot with extra steps.

ROUTE: whole-image relight -> composite only the region back. NOT a localised crop/stitch - every model re-grades the returned patch and leaves a visible rectangle. Boogu, Klein and Qwen at three tiers were all measured; do not re-open the model search.

The composite-back is a GRAPH TAIL, not an app-side step: ImageBlend(difference) -> ImageToMask -> ThresholdMask -> GrowMaskWithBlur -> ImageCompositeMasked, all core nodes. ONE dispatch, capabilities.multiStage stays FALSE.

Input_Control_strength ships at 0.45-0.60 and the SLIDER IS MANDATORY (Fabio: 'the strength control that we have on the original workflow needs to be the same for this flow'). Correctness, not convenience - at 0.8 the user's ink renders as garment seams.

The shadow is NOT a user toggle and the blend pass is ALWAYS ON. The prompt already makes the shadow conditional on the scene's light, so a toggle re-introduces the unconditional instruction session 3 removed.

Medium is a MODEL-SELECTION problem - 'match the scene's art style' does not restyle a photoreal object onto a cel-shaded plate. This is why the picker is load-bearing for CORRECTNESS here, not just convenience.
constraints: modelParams injection matches node TITLES and drops an unmatched one in SILENCE - no error anywhere. With five SDXL arms that is five chances to ship a dead pick. tests/flow-model-choice.test.cjs asserts every key names a title that EXISTS in the flow's graph; extend it to this flow BEFORE trusting a live run.
